summary: Tested the backend and frontend of the tank-size guess, the Confirm levels dialog, the engine battery changes and the Ship's Log amounts. Test boat: test-user-pro/main (TEST_Kia Ora), viewport 430x900. Backend: 11 of 12 pytest pass, 1 skipped. The skipped one is the 403 test: the FIRST200 launch promo makes every user premium, so no account can get a 403. Frontend: every requested flow passed after one small CSS fix. 1) Additional Boat Details > Vessel Telemetry lists House bank, then 'Using an engine battery' (checked by default), then Engine battery. Unticking hides the engine row and saves engine_battery_off=true, which is still set after a reload. Re-ticking shows the row again. 2) The Leaving the Dock check lists House bank first, then Engine battery as a solid green Full (rgb 4,120,87) with a checked, disabled 'Monitor alternator during trip' box. With the engine battery off, it is not shown and the collapsed summary reads 'House bank: not set'. 3) DEPART opens 'Confirm your levels before you depart'. Order: Fuel (TANK SIZE), LPG (No of bottles, Size kg), Water (TANK SIZE), House bank (Amp hours, prefilled 160), 'Using an engine battery', then Engine battery Full + Monitor. Engine is never listed as missing. Unticking hides the engine row. Cancel saves nothing (fuel stayed blank; it goes through the discard-changes prompt). Number inputs reject letters ('1a2.55' becomes '12.5'). On arrival the levels were prefilled, with engine 'full'. Entering fuel 200, LPG 2 x 4.5, water 300, house 200 Ah and unticking the engine battery all saved to the boat on Confirm. 4) Ship's Log with no tank sizes: 'Departure check ...: Fuel 3/4. Water 3/4. LPG 3/4. Batteries: House bank 160Ah 3/4, Engine battery Full (monitor alternator during trip).' It has no 'about 0 L'. With sizes and the engine battery off: 'Arrival check (Returning to Dock): Fuel 1/2 (about 100 L left). Water 1/4 - LOW (about 75 L left). LPG 1/2 (about 4.5 kg left). Batteries: House bank 1/2 (was 3/4). Used on the passage ...: fuel about 50 L, water about 150 L, LPG about 2.3 kg.' No engine battery appears. 5) Background guess: with Magic asks available, one /ai/tank-guess call about 2.5 s after load returned fuel 130, water 330, 2 x 3 kg, 160 Ah. It filled only the empty fields (a fuel_tank of 150 that I set was kept), set tank_guess_for='beneteau|oceanis 38|2014', showed the toast 'Magic Marine Navigator filled in your tank sizes, LPG and house bank...', and did not call again. BUG FOUND: the Pro user had 0 Magic asks, so the background call on page load returned 429 and opened the 'You've used all your Magic - Buy +50 for NZ$10' upsell dialog without the skipper doing anything.

minor.issue: The 403 test could not be run: the FIRST200 launch promo (first200_cached) makes test-user-free premium. require_premium itself is in place. Validation 422s (empty make, missing model, year '14'/'20145'/'abcd', bad units/tank_units) and the 401 all pass. The live call returned clamped numbers.

ui_bugs.issue: When the user has no Magic asks left, the unprompted background call gets 429 daily_limit. The api.js interceptor then fires MAGIC_LIMIT_EVENT, so the 'You've used all your Magic' buy dialog opens on page load. Reproduced as test-user-pro on /app.

'ready' only checks make, model, year and tank_guess_for. It never checks whether any fuel/water/LPG/house Ah field is empty. So every existing Pro boat with make, model and year spends one Magic ask (and may trigger the upsell above) even when all sizes are already filled in, just to set tank_guess_for. The spec says 'for ... empty tank sizes'.

issues: FIXED by testing agent: in App.css, .field-input sets width:100% outside any CSS layer, which overrode the Tailwind w-16. The TANK SIZE / No of bottles / Size / Amp hours boxes stretched to full width, so the labels wrapped onto two lines and LPG split over two rows. Changed to !w-16 and added whitespace-nowrap on the label; each field now sits on its title line (checked by screenshot).

The disabled 'Monitor alternator during trip' checkbox shows in browser-default grey, because accent-green-700 is not applied to disabled inputs. It reads as faded or inactive next to the green Full. Optional: style it so it looks green and ticked.

action_items: useTankGuess: don't open the MagicLimitDialog for this background call. For example, send a header or config flag that the api.js interceptor skips, or check quota first and skip the call when asks_left is 0.
useTankGuess: add to 'ready' a check that at least one of fuel_tank, water_tank, gas_bottles, gas_kg or the house battery Ah is empty, so no ask is spent on boats that are already fully set up.
Optional: decide whether a failed or 429 guess should permanently set tank_guess_for (it does now, so no retry after the user buys more asks).
critical_code_review_comments: useTankGuess sets tank_guess_for even when the call fails (catch, then mutate). After a 429 or 503 it never retries for that make/model/year.
useTankGuess computes 'told' from the boat in the render closure, while mutate uses the latest state. A field typed during the 2.5 s plus LLM wait could make the toast wrong. Minor.
LevelsConfirmDialog: Cancel after edits goes through the global discard-changes guard. Works, but it is one extra step.
Backend parse_tanks clamps values correctly (unit tested) and refunds the ask on failure.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all requested flows pass; 1 HIGH bug in the background guess UX)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily gave test-user-pro +2 purchased Magic asks (both used, now back to 0). Put test-user-pro/main on a today's departure with seed_pro_depart_today.py, then departed and arrived through the UI. Afterwards I restored the whole boat doc from a mongoexport backup (/tmp/pro_main_backup.json): Ship's Log back to 19 entries, tank sizes blank, no tank_guess_for or engine_battery_off. Gave test-user-free back the 2 asks used by the pytest live calls (free_used back to 2). The ai_drafts and ai_usage rows from 4 LLM calls remain. The depart and arrive steps notified the boat's test shore contacts (example.com accounts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use cookie session_token=test_session_pro_1 at 430x900. Dismiss dialogs with the 'Not now' and 'Continue' buttons and Escape. test-user-pro has 0 Magic asks, and main has make/model/year with blank tanks and no tank_guess_for, so every fresh load fires /ai/tank-guess (429 and the upsell dialog until fixed). To reach Confirm levels: run 'MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database python /app/backend/tests/seed_pro_depart_today.py' (back up the boat first with mongoexport), then list-selector, list-option-leavingDock, depart-all-done-btn. Pick level-confirm-{k}-3q, then levels-confirm-btn, then all-done-confirm-btn. Arrival: vessel-arrived-all-done-btn opens the arrival Confirm levels, then all-done-confirm-btn (Log arrival). A Cancel after edits needs discard-changes-confirm-btn.
rca of the issue: Customer case ('Fuel Full (about 0 L left)'): fixed, because departureSummary and arrivalSummary now add amounts only when sized() is true. Verified in the live Ship's Log with blank sizes and with sizes set. New bug: the background guess goes through the shared axios instance, and its response interceptor sends any 429 daily_limit to MagicLimitDialog. Repro: Pro user with 0 asks, boat with make/model/year and no tank_guess_for, open /app, and the upsell dialog appears about 3 s later. Mitigation: suppress the event for this call, or pre-check quota.
